title: Everrealm Survival
description: A no-reset survival server where player builds are meant to stay.
body:
# Everrealm Survival

![Everrealm Survival - A World With History](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cd1a68eb24d1be331b5d0e661c3409b2b3b04b3_0.webp)

**Everrealm Survival** is the international name of **无名世界**, a long-term Minecraft survival server built around one simple promise:

**No world resets. No seasonal wipes. Your builds are meant to stay.**

Everrealm is not a seasonal server, not a short-term wipe server, and not a pay-to-win progression server. It is a persistent survival world where player-made bases, roads, farms, towns, shops, and landmarks can become part of the server’s long-term history.

The original community is Chinese, but players of all languages are welcome. English is recommended for communication, and Chinese is preferred when possible. The server is currently rebuilding activity, so it is best suited for players who enjoy smaller communities, slow-paced survival, and long-term projects.

---

## Quick Info

- **Version:** 1.21.4
- **Edition:** Java Edition
- **World resets:** No
- **Seasonal wipes:** No
- **Map replacement:** No
- **Pay-to-win:** No
- **Original community:** Chinese
- **Languages:** All languages are welcome. English is recommended, and Chinese is preferred when possible.
- **Bedrock Edition:** Not confirmed yet

---

## Join

### Java Edition

```text
world-mc.cn
```

### Bedrock Edition

Bedrock support is not confirmed yet.
This page will be updated if Bedrock access becomes available.

---

## What kind of server is this?

Everrealm Survival is a relaxed, survival-focused community server.

It is best suited for players who enjoy:

* Long-term survival
* Building homes, towns, roads, farms, and landmarks
* Redstone and technical survival projects
* Player trading and community interaction
* Slow-paced progression
* Smaller communities
* A persistent world with real history

This is a place for players who want to settle down and leave something behind.

![Community Survival Night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d77d2dda6c7920e6dd55bade52ba134740ff6ad1_0.webp)

---

## What makes Everrealm different?

Many Minecraft servers are built around seasons.

You join, you build, you progress, and the world never resets.

Everrealm takes a different approach.

The world is meant to continue. Player builds are not treated as temporary content. A house, road, base, shop, or town can become part of the server’s long-term history.

**One world. Long-term survival. No wipes.**

![Players Together](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51d60b93f07603c1ae3db800ba169d64ceb41e2f_0.webp)

---

## Basic Rules

Please do not:

* Use hacked clients, x-ray, or unfair modifications
* Grief or destroy other players’ builds
* Steal from other players
* Abuse bugs, exploits, or duplication glitches
* Intentionally create lag machines
* Harass or insult other players
* Spam chat

Respect other players’ time, builds, and bases.

Because this is a no-reset world, griefing is taken seriously.

---

## Community Revival

Everrealm has been quiet for a while, but the world is still here.

We are now working on improving:

* New player guidance
* English onboarding
* Server descriptions
* Community announcements
* Build showcases
* Player history archives
* Small community events

If you like small, persistent Minecraft worlds with real history, you are welcome to join and help shape the next stage of the server.

![Server Gathering](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec86f22d951237e7a8dc25aec0e29f2a5901cfd0.jpeg)

---

## Final Note

Everrealm is not trying to be the biggest server.

It is trying to be a world that lasts.

**Not a season. Not a wipe. A world with history.**
